name: @papercupai/firecrawl-bridge
description: Managed Firecrawl access for heavy research workloads — PDFs, JS-rendered pages, structured extraction with JSON schemas, and site-wide crawls. Wraps the Firecrawl API (firecrawl.dev) so agents get more capability than fetch-plus's Jina Reader. Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
author: Papercusp

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Fetch one URL and return clean markdown. Like fetch-plus but uses Firecrawl's full extraction stack (PDFs, JS-rendered pages, screenshots optional). Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY. Use fetch-plus first; reach for this when fetch-plus fails or when you need a screenshot/structured extraction.

guidance.when: Fetch one URL with the full Firecrawl extraction stack — better than fetch_plus for PDF or JS-heavy sites.
guidance.notWhen: For SIMPLE markdown extraction, `fetch_plus.fetch_clean` is cheaper. For STRUCTURED extraction, use `firecrawl.extract`.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from a URL given a JSON schema describing the desired shape. Firecrawl uses an LLM under the hood to fill the schema. Use for 'give me an array of {name, price, url} from this product listing' workflows.

schema.description: JSON Schema describing the desired output shape.

prompt.description: Optional natural-language hint to guide extraction.

guidance.when: Pull structured JSON from a URL given a schema describing the desired shape. Use when you need typed data, not free-text markdown.
guidance.notWhen: For free-text content, use `firecrawl.scrape` or `fetch_plus.fetch_clean`. extract costs more (LLM-driven).

tools.name: map
tools.description: Discover all URLs reachable from a starting URL — fast, no scraping. Use to plan a crawl or to enumerate a doc-site's pages before fetching specific ones.

guidance.when: Enumerate every URL reachable from a starting URL — fast crawl, no content extraction. Use to plan a crawl.
guidance.notWhen: For getting CONTENT, follow up with `firecrawl.scrape` or `fetch_plus.fetch_clean` per URL.
guidance.chaining: Pair with `firecrawl.scrape` to actually fetch the URLs map returns.

apiBase.description: API base URL. Override for self-hosted Firecrawl instances.

inlineThresholdChars.description: Outputs smaller than this returned inline; larger ones written to .papercusp/scratch/.
